		plot_outcome.fill(OUTCOME_UNRESOLVED)
		# field_present, participants, resolved, withdrawn, completed_cycles and cancelled_cycles
		# are zero in clear(), which resize() has already written.


static func columns_refusal(columns: Columns) -> StringName:
	"""REFUSE_NONE when this saved column image is internally coherent, else its refusal code.

	Fixed observable order: global shape, global byte domains, global rotation domains, then
	ascending field rows (zone, counters, state, request), then the ascending plot ledger, then
	exact OPEN-cycle counts. Argument-only: no store state is read or written.
	"""
	var code: StringName = _columns_shape_refusal(columns)
	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
		return code
	code = _columns_flag_refusal(columns)
	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
		return code
	code = _columns_rotation_refusal(columns)
	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
		return code
	for field: int in FIELD_CAPACITY:
		code = _field_row_refusal(columns, field)
		if code != REFUSE_NONE:
			return code
	code = _plot_ledger_refusal(columns)
	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
		return code
	return _open_counts_refusal(columns)


static func _columns_shape_refusal(columns: Columns) -> StringName:
	"""COLUMN_SHAPE unless the image exists and all 20 columns carry their declared extents."""
	if columns == null:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_SHAPE
	if not _field_extents_ok(columns):
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_SHAPE
	if columns.plot_field_slot.size() != PLOT_CAPACITY \
			or columns.plot_cycle.size() != PLOT_CAPACITY \
			or columns.plot_outcome.size() != PLOT_CAPACITY:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_SHAPE
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _field_extents_ok(columns: Columns) -> bool:
	"""True when the six byte and ten int32 field columns are 128 and rotation_ids is 384."""
	if columns.field_present.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.auto_rotation.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.seed_reserve.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.cycle_state.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.close_reason.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.request_state.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY:
		return false
	if columns.zone_slot.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.zone_generation.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.rotation_cursor.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.cycle_ordinal.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.participants.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.resolved.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.withdrawn.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.completed_cycles.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.cancelled_cycles.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY \
			or columns.requested_crop.size() != FIELD_CAPACITY:
		return false
	return columns.rotation_ids.size() == FIELD_CAPACITY * ROTATION_LENGTH


static func _columns_flag_refusal(columns: Columns) -> StringName:
	"""COLUMN_FLAGS unless every byte column stays inside its declared enum or 0/1 domain."""
	if not _bytes_within(columns.field_present, 1) \
			or not _bytes_within(columns.auto_rotation, 1) \
			or not _bytes_within(columns.seed_reserve, 1) \
			or not _bytes_within(columns.cycle_state, CYCLE_STATE_COUNT - 1) \
			or not _bytes_within(columns.close_reason, CLOSE_REASON_COUNT - 1) \
			or not _bytes_within(columns.request_state, REQUEST_STATE_COUNT - 1) \
			or not _bytes_within(columns.plot_outcome, OUTCOME_COUNT - 1):
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_FLAGS
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _bytes_within(column: PackedByteArray, high: int) -> bool:
	"""True when every unsigned byte of this column is at most `high`."""
	for value: int in column:
		if value > high:
			return false
	return true


static func _ints_within(column: PackedInt32Array, low: int, high: int) -> bool:
	"""True when every int32 of this column lies inside the inclusive range [low, high]."""
	for value: int in column:
		if value < low or value > high:
			return false
	return true


static func _columns_rotation_refusal(columns: Columns) -> StringName:
	"""COLUMN_ROTATION unless every entry, cursor and requested crop is in farming.gd's domain."""
	if not _ints_within(columns.rotation_ids, NO_CROP, FarmingScript.CROP_COUNT - 1) \
			or not _ints_within(columns.rotation_cursor, 0, ROTATION_LENGTH - 1) \
			or not _ints_within(columns.requested_crop, NO_CROP, FarmingScript.CROP_COUNT - 1):
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_ROTATION
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _field_row_refusal(columns: Columns, field: int) -> StringName:
	"""One field row in contract order: zone reference, counters, state, then request."""
	var present: bool = columns.field_present[field] == 1
	var code: StringName = _zone_ref_refusal(columns, field, present)
	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
		return code
	code = _counters_refusal(columns, field)
	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
		return code
	code = _state_refusal(columns, field, present)
	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
		return code
	return _request_refusal(columns, field, present)


static func _zone_ref_refusal(columns: Columns, field: int, present: bool) -> StringName:
	"""COLUMN_ZONE_REF unless the pair is structurally legal; a positive generation may be stale."""
	var slot: int = columns.zone_slot[field]
	var generation: int = columns.zone_generation[field]
	if not present:
		if slot != EntityDirectory.NULL_SLOT or generation != EntityDirectory.NULL_GENERATION:
			return REFUSE_COLUMN_ZONE_REF
		return REFUSE_NONE
	if slot < 0 or slot >= EntityDirectory.DIRECTORY_CAPACITY or generation <= 0:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_ZONE_REF
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _counters_refusal(columns: Columns, field: int) -> StringName:
	"""COLUMN_COUNTERS unless this row's ordinal, history and participant counts agree."""
	var ordinal: int = columns.cycle_ordinal[field]
	var completed: int = columns.completed_cycles[field]
	var cancelled: int = columns.cancelled_cycles[field]
	if ordinal < NO_CYCLE or completed < 0 or cancelled < 0:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_COUNTERS
	if completed + cancelled > ordinal:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_COUNTERS
	var participants: int = columns.participants[field]
	var resolved: int = columns.resolved[field]
	var withdrawn: int = columns.withdrawn[field]
	if participants < 0 or resolved < 0 or withdrawn < 0:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_COUNTERS
	if participants > PLOT_CAPACITY or resolved > PLOT_CAPACITY or withdrawn > PLOT_CAPACITY:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_COUNTERS
	if resolved > participants or participants + withdrawn > PLOT_CAPACITY:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_COUNTERS
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _state_refusal(columns: Columns, field: int, present: bool) -> StringName:
	"""COLUMN_STATE: the current cycle table first, then the retained-history relations."""
	var code: StringName = _cycle_state_refusal(columns, field, present)
	if code != REFUSE_NONE:
		return code
	return _retained_history_refusal(columns, field)


static func _cycle_state_refusal(columns: Columns, field: int, present: bool) -> StringName:
	"""The IDLE / OPEN / CLOSED table for one row, present or not."""
	var state: int = columns.cycle_state[field]
	if not present:
		if state != CYCLE_IDLE or columns.participants[field] != 0 \
				or columns.resolved[field] != 0:
			return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
		return REFUSE_NONE
	if state == CYCLE_IDLE:
		return _idle_state_refusal(columns, field)
	if state == CYCLE_OPEN:
		return _open_state_refusal(columns, field)
	return _closed_state_refusal(columns, field)


static func _idle_state_refusal(columns: Columns, field: int) -> StringName:
	"""A present IDLE row carries the reset counts; its ordinal may be positive after recreation."""
	if columns.participants[field] != 0 or columns.resolved[field] != 0 \
			or columns.withdrawn[field] != 0 or columns.completed_cycles[field] != 0 \
			or columns.cancelled_cycles[field] != 0 \
			or columns.close_reason[field] != CLOSE_NONE:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _open_state_refusal(columns: Columns, field: int) -> StringName:
	"""An OPEN cycle has a positive ordinal, no close reason and an unresolved shape."""
	if columns.cycle_ordinal[field] <= NO_CYCLE or columns.close_reason[field] != CLOSE_NONE:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	var participants: int = columns.participants[field]
	if participants == 0:
		if columns.resolved[field] != 0 or columns.withdrawn[field] != 0:
			return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
		return REFUSE_NONE
	if columns.resolved[field] >= participants:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _closed_state_refusal(columns: Columns, field: int) -> StringName:
	"""A CLOSED cycle's counts must match the close reason _close_cycle() recorded."""
	var reason: int = columns.close_reason[field]
	if columns.cycle_ordinal[field] <= NO_CYCLE or reason == CLOSE_NONE:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	var participants: int = columns.participants[field]
	var resolved: int = columns.resolved[field]
	if reason == CLOSE_COMPLETED:
		if participants <= 0 or resolved != participants \
				or columns.completed_cycles[field] <= 0:
			return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
		return REFUSE_NONE
	if reason == CLOSE_CANCELLED:
		return _cancelled_state_refusal(columns, field)
	if participants != 0 or resolved != 0 or columns.withdrawn[field] <= 0:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _cancelled_state_refusal(columns: Columns, field: int) -> StringName:
	"""A cancelled cycle counts its cancellation and keeps a former OPEN unresolved shape."""
	var participants: int = columns.participants[field]
	var resolved: int = columns.resolved[field]
	if columns.cancelled_cycles[field] <= 0:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	if participants == 0:
		if resolved != 0 or columns.withdrawn[field] != 0:
			return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
		return REFUSE_NONE
	if resolved >= participants:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _retained_history_refusal(columns: Columns, field: int) -> StringName:
	"""The retained close-reason relations every writer leaves behind, on any row.

	They hold on inactive rows too: destroy_policy() keeps the close reason, the settings and
	the durable counts, and a retained reason is never recomputed here.
	"""
	var reason: int = columns.close_reason[field]
	var ordinal: int = columns.cycle_ordinal[field]
	var withdrawn: int = columns.withdrawn[field]
	if reason != CLOSE_NONE and ordinal <= NO_CYCLE:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	if reason == CLOSE_COMPLETED and columns.completed_cycles[field] <= 0:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	if reason == CLOSE_CANCELLED and columns.cancelled_cycles[field] <= 0:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	if reason == CLOSE_ABANDONED and withdrawn <= 0:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	if withdrawn > 0 and ordinal <= NO_CYCLE:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_STATE
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _request_refusal(columns: Columns, field: int, present: bool) -> StringName:
	"""COLUMN_REQUEST unless a retained request matches the row that could have made it.

	auto_rotation is NOT required to still be on: a request retained before it was switched off
	is legitimate. No calendar is recomputed, so every declared window state is accepted.
	"""
	var request: int = columns.request_state[field]
	var crop: int = columns.requested_crop[field]
	if request == REQUEST_NONE:
		if crop != NO_CROP:
			return REFUSE_COLUMN_REQUEST
		return REFUSE_NONE
	if not present or columns.cycle_state[field] != CYCLE_CLOSED \
			or columns.close_reason[field] != CLOSE_COMPLETED:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_REQUEST
	var cursor: int = columns.rotation_cursor[field]
	if crop != columns.rotation_ids[field * ROTATION_LENGTH + cursor]:
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_REQUEST
	if (request == REQUEST_ENTRY_NOT_CONFIGURED) != (crop == NO_CROP):
		return REFUSE_COLUMN_REQUEST
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _plot_ledger_refusal(columns: Columns) -> StringName:
	"""COLUMN_PLOT_LEDGER unless every enrolment row is null or names a legal field stamp.

	A linked field may be inactive, IDLE, CLOSED or OPEN with a newer ordinal: stale outcomes
	are retained history, so only the link, the positive stamp and the ordinal bound are checked.
	"""
	for plot: int in PLOT_CAPACITY:
		var field: int = columns.plot_field_slot[plot]
		if field == NO_FIELD:
			if columns.plot_cycle[plot] != NO_CYCLE \
					or columns.plot_outcome[plot] != OUTCOME_UNRESOLVED:
				return REFUSE_COLUMN_PLOT_LEDGER
			continue
		if field < 0 or field >= FIELD_CAPACITY:
			return REFUSE_COLUMN_PLOT_LEDGER
		var cycle: int = columns.plot_cycle[plot]
		if cycle < FIRST_CYCLE or cycle > columns.cycle_ordinal[field]:
			return REFUSE_COLUMN_PLOT_LEDGER
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _open_counts_refusal(columns: Columns) -> StringName:
	"""COLUMN_OPEN_COUNTS unless every OPEN row's counts equal its current-stamp ledger.

	Closed counts are history and are never reconstructed. The three scratch columns are
	allocated only after the scalar and ledger checks pass and only when an OPEN row exists.
	"""
	if not _has_open_field(columns):
		return REFUSE_NONE
	var participants: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
	var resolved: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
	var withdrawn: PackedInt32Array = PackedInt32Array()
	participants.resize(FIELD_CAPACITY)
	resolved.resize(FIELD_CAPACITY)
	withdrawn.resize(FIELD_CAPACITY)
	for plot: int in PLOT_CAPACITY:
		var field: int = columns.plot_field_slot[plot]
		if not _is_current_open_stamp(columns, field, plot):
			continue
		var outcome: int = columns.plot_outcome[plot]
		if outcome == OUTCOME_WITHDRAWN:
			withdrawn[field] += 1
			continue
		participants[field] += 1
		if outcome == OUTCOME_HARVESTED or outcome == OUTCOME_CLEARED:
			resolved[field] += 1
	return _compare_open_counts(columns, participants, resolved, withdrawn)


static func _compare_open_counts(columns: Columns, participants: PackedInt32Array,
		resolved: PackedInt32Array, withdrawn: PackedInt32Array) -> StringName:
	"""Compare every OPEN row's three stored counts against the tallied scratch columns."""
	for field: int in FIELD_CAPACITY:
		if not _is_open_field(columns, field):
			continue
		if participants[field] != columns.participants[field] \
				or resolved[field] != columns.resolved[field] \
				or withdrawn[field] != columns.withdrawn[field]:
			return REFUSE_COLUMN_OPEN_COUNTS
	return REFUSE_NONE


static func _is_open_field(columns: Columns, field: int) -> bool:
	"""True when this row holds a policy whose cycle is currently OPEN."""
	return columns.field_present[field] == 1 and columns.cycle_state[field] == CYCLE_OPEN


static func _is_current_open_stamp(columns: Columns, field: int, plot: int) -> bool:
	"""True when this enrolment names an OPEN field and carries that field's current ordinal."""
	if field == NO_FIELD or not _is_open_field(columns, field):
		return false
	return columns.plot_cycle[plot] == columns.cycle_ordinal[field]


static func _has_open_field(columns: Columns) -> bool:
	"""True when any row holds an OPEN cycle, so the exact count scan has something to compare."""
	for field: int in FIELD_CAPACITY:
		if _is_open_field(columns, field):
			return true
	return false
